ethics: Community and faith dietary patterns are described for cultural competence and voluntary user preference — never for ranking, exclusion, or discrimination. Caste is referenced only as historical customary foodways some users self-identify with; the system does not assign caste.

religious_calendars.name: Navratri / common vrata pattern
religious_calendars.pattern: Many observe grain restrictions, vrat foods (kuttu, singhara, potato, milk, fruits) varying by family
nutrition_tips: Plan protein via dairy/nuts if permitted
Avoid deep-fried vrat snacks as default
religious_calendars.medical: Diabetes: vrat potato/sabudana load can spike glucose — clinician plan

religious_calendars.name: Ekadashi fasting patterns
religious_calendars.pattern: Partial or full fasts; fruits, milk, or specific allowed foods by sampradaya
nutrition_tips: Elderly/pregnant/ill often exempt — religious + medical counsel
religious_calendars.medical: Do not fast if contraindicated (ED history, uncontrolled diabetes, etc.)

religious_calendars.name: Jain vegetarian / root restrictions (where observed)
religious_calendars.pattern: Lacto-vegetarian; many avoid root tubers, strict filters on water/ferments in orthoprax households
nutrition_tips: B12 from dairy or supplements if strict
religious_calendars.medical: Very strict patterns need B12/iron monitoring

religious_calendars.name: Langar / simple sattvic-style community meals
religious_calendars.pattern: Vegetarian langar norm in gurdwaras; home diets vary
nutrition_tips: Dal, roti, sabzi, kheer pattern is balanced if portions sane

religious_calendars.name: Ramadan fasting
religious_calendars.pattern: Dawn-to-sunset fast; suhoor and iftar meals
nutrition_tips: Iftar: date + water then balanced meal
religious_calendars.medical: Medical exemptions exist; diabetes fasting only with physician protocol

religious_calendars.name: Lent / Friday abstinence (where observed)
religious_calendars.pattern: Variable meat abstinence or simple meals by denomination

religious_calendars.name: Vegetarian preference (lineage-dependent)
religious_calendars.pattern: Many Indian Buddhist communities vegetarian or reduce meat

religious_calendars.name: Parsi home cuisine patterns
religious_calendars.pattern: Mixed diet with distinctive sweets and seafood in coastal families

customary_community_foodways.note: Users may optionally self-describe community foodway. System never infers caste from name/location.

genz_patterns.name: GenZ high-protein / gym diet
balance: Not all calories from protein powder

genz_patterns.name: GenZ intermittent fasting
risks: Contraindicated in pregnancy, ED, some diabetes — medical advice
